description: Three identical logic gates, each with three inputs and a plain and an inverted output, working per polyphonic channel

inputs.text: The first of that gate's three inputs, read as high above 2V; with this and the second patched and the third empty, the gate is an XOR of the two
The second of that gate's three inputs, read as high above 2V; with this and the third patched and the first empty, the gate is an AND of the two
The third of that gate's three inputs, read as high above 2V; with this and the second patched and the first empty, the gate is an AND of the two

outputs.text: A 10V gate while that gate's result is true and 0V while it is false, carrying as many polyphonic channels as the widest of its three inputs
A 10V gate while that gate's result is false and 0V while it is true, carrying as many polyphonic channels as the widest of its three inputs

notes: any patching other than those two pairs makes a gate an OR of its inputs, so the XOR, OR and AND printed on the panel say which inputs to patch rather than what one gate is fixed to do
